## Purpose
The template map model: the classification as one tree, each node carrying the template that applies to it and where that template is set. It is computed from two cheap reads (the process tree and the scopes with their own templates), without a request per node.

## Responsibilities
- `MapLevel`, `MapNode`, `GLOBAL_KEY` and `keyOf`.
- `buildMap`, `flatten`, `find`, `inheritors` and `LEVEL_LABEL`.
